$comment: The essay shelf: the one committed list of which essays are public. Read by client/src/lib/shelf.ts (the site) and scripts/lib/shelf.mjs (sitemap, prerender, llms-full, catalogue). Status live = on the shelf now; pending = being revised, live only once client/public/essays/<slug>.json exists. Any essay not listed here is retired (noindex, out of every listing) unless it was created at or after latestCutoff, which is how new posts from the admin appear on their own. To bring an essay back, add one line here. blurb is the line shown under the title on /writing; omit it to use the essay's own excerpt, or set it to "" for no line.
